note: Remote behavior config. Proven-good against the live CDN (origin-probe 2026-08-09): SETTING Origin+Referer to cloudorchestranova.com returns 200. We SET rather than remove the Origin because Chrome DNR reliably supports set (remove on Origin can be rejected, which silently disables the whole rule set). Works on every extension version >= 2.0.0, so no reinstall needed for rule changes.
